description.ko: 혈당 부담이 낮은 재료로 구성한 아침 식사용 귀리 볼입니다.

instruction.en: Pour 150ml of unsweetened almond milk into a pot.
Turn the heat to low.
Add 50g of rolled oats.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon.
Turn off the heat and transfer to a bowl.
Top with 40g of blueberries.
Top with 10g of almonds.

description.ko: 혈당 부담이 낮은 재료로 구성한 점심용 렌틸콩 채소 수프입니다.

benefits.ko: 식물성 단백질과 식이섬유가 풍부한 콩류예요.

benefits.en: Contains quercetin, a plant compound found in many vegetables.

benefits.en: Adds savory depth, but store-bought versions tend to be higher in sodium, so use it sparingly.

instruction.en: Dice 50g of onion.
Dice 40g of carrot.
Place a pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and carrot, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add 80g of lentils.
Pour in 300ml of vegetable stock.
Once it boils, reduce to low heat and simmer for 20 minutes.

benefits.ko: 비타민 C와 식이섬유가 풍부한 십자화과 채소예요.

benefits.ko: 비타민 C가 풍부하고 상큼한 산미를 더해줘요.
benefits.en: Rich in vitamin C and adds bright acidity.

instruction.en: Heat a pan over medium heat.
Place the 120g mackerel skin-side down.
Sprinkle on just a small pinch of salt.
Cook for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook for another 4 minutes.

instruction.ko: 냄비에 물을 끓여 브로콜리 80g을 넣고 2분간 데친다.
instruction.en: Boil water in a pot, add 80g of broccoli, and blanch for 2 minutes.
Drizzle 5ml of olive oil over the blanched broccoli.
Squeeze the juice of 1/4 lemon over the plate.

benefits.ko: 오메가-3 지방산이 들어 있는 견과류예요.
benefits.en: A nut that contains omega-3 fatty acids.

instruction.en: Pour 180ml of water into a pot.
Add 50g of buckwheat groats.
Turn the heat to low.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Dice 60g of apple.
Turn off the heat and transfer to a bowl.
Top with the diced apple and 10g of walnuts.

description.ko: 전날 밤 재워두면 아침에 바로 먹을 수 있는 푸딩입니다.

benefits.ko: 향신료로 소량만 써도 단맛 없이 풍미를 더할 수 있어요.

instruction.en: Put 25g of chia seeds into a jar or bowl.
Pour in 150ml of unsweetened almond milk.
Add 1g of ground cinnamon.
Stir well with a spoon.
Cover and place in the refrigerator.
Let it sit for at least 6 hours.
Take it out and top with 40g of raspberries.

description.ko: 쫄깃한 보리와 배를 함께 낸 담백한 아침 볼입니다.

Turn the heat to medium-low.
Simmer for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Thinly slice 60g of pear.
Turn off the heat and transfer to a bowl.
Top with the sliced pear and 10g of almonds.

benefits.ko: 식이섬유와 항산화 성분이 풍부한 베리류예요.

benefits.ko: 마그네슘과 불포화지방이 들어 있는 씨앗이에요.

instruction.en: Put the rinsed quinoa and 120ml of unsweetened almond milk into a pot.
Turn the heat to low.
Simmer for 12 minutes.
Turn off the heat and transfer to a bowl.
Top with 40g of blackberries and 10g of pumpkin seeds.

benefits.ko: 식이섬유가 풍부한 통곡물로 포만감 유지에 도움이 될 수 있어요.

benefits.ko: 식이섬유와 칼륨이 들어 있는 과일이에요.

benefits.ko: 불포화지방과 비타민 E가 들어 있는 견과류예요.
benefits.en: Contains unsaturated fats and vitamin E.

instruction.en: Pour 180ml of water into a pot.
Add 50g of rye flakes.
Turn the heat to low.
Simmer for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Thinly slice 40g of fig.
Turn off the heat and transfer to a bowl.
Top with the sliced fig and 10g of hazelnuts.

description.ko: 부드러운 좁쌀 포리지에 자두의 산미를 더했습니다.
description.en: A soft millet porridge lifted by the tartness of plum.

benefits.ko: 글루텐이 없는 잡곡으로 소화가 비교적 편한 편이에요.

benefits.ko: 식이섬유와 항산화 성분이 들어 있는 과일이에요.

Simmer for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Turn off the heat and transfer to a bowl.
Top with the sliced plum and 10g of sunflower seeds.

benefits.ko: 식물성 단백질과 식이섬유가 풍부한 콩류예요.

benefits.ko: 식이섬유인 베타글루칸이 풍부한 통곡물이에요.

benefits.ko: 불포화지방 비중이 높은 식물성 기름이에요.

benefits.ko: 비타민 C를 더해주고 소금 없이도 감칠맛을 살려줘요.
benefits.en: Adds vitamin C and brightens flavor without needing extra salt.

instruction.ko: 냄비에 물을 끓여 렌틸콩 70g을 넣고 15분간 삶는다.
instruction.en: Boil water in a pot, add 70g of lentils, and cook for 15 minutes.

instruction.ko: 다른 냄비에 물을 끓여 찰보리 50g을 넣고 20분간 삶는다.
instruction.en: In another pot, boil water, add 50g of pearl barley, and cook for 20 minutes.

instruction.ko: 삶은 렌틸콩과 보리를 체에 밭쳐 물기를 빼고 식힌다.
instruction.en: Drain the cooked lentils and barley in a strainer and let them cool.
Halve 60g of cherry tomatoes.

instruction.ko: 큰 그릇에 식힌 렌틸콩, 보리, 방울토마토, 루꼴라 40g을 담는다.
instruction.en: Put the cooled lentils, barley, cherry tomatoes, and 40g of arugula into a large bowl.
Drizzle with 10ml of olive oil and 10ml of lemon juice.
Toss gently with a spoon.

description.ko: 구운 병아리콩과 케일을 현미와 함께 낸 볼입니다.
description.en: Roasted chickpeas and kale served over brown rice.

benefits.ko: 식물성 단백질과 식이섬유가 풍부한 콩류예요.
benefits.en: A legume rich in plant-based protein and fiber.

benefits.en: A leafy green rich in vitamin K and vitamin C.

benefits.ko: 불포화지방 비중이 높은 식물성 기름이에요.

benefits.ko: 알리신이라는 화합물이 들어 있는 향신채예요.
benefits.en: Contains allicin, a compound formed when garlic is crushed.

instruction.en: Finely mince 5g of garlic.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add 10ml of olive oil.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add 80g of chickpeas and sauté for 3 minutes.
Tear 60g of kale by hand and add it to the pan.

instruction.ko: 잎이 숨이 죽을 때까지 2분간 더 볶는다.
instruction.en: Sauté for 2 more minutes until the leaves wilt.
Put 100g of cooked brown rice into a bowl.

instruction.ko: 볶은 병아리콩과 케일을 그 위에 올린다.
instruction.en: Top with the sautéed chickpeas and kale.

description.ko: 차게 낸 메밀국수에 두부와 채소를 곁들였습니다.

benefits.ko: 수분 함량이 높은 채소예요.

benefits.ko: 칼슘과 불포화지방이 들어 있는 씨앗이에요.

instruction.en: Boil water in a pot and add 70g of buckwheat noodles.
Cook for the time listed on the package.

instruction.ko: 삶은 국수를 체에 밭쳐 찬물에 헹군다.
instruction.en: Drain the noodles in a strainer and rinse under cold water.
Cut 100g of tofu into thick slices.
Julienne 50g of cucumber into thin strips.

instruction.ko: 그릇에 국수를 담고 두부와 오이를 올린다.
instruction.en: Put the noodles in a bowl and top with the tofu and cucumber.
Drizzle with 5ml of sesame oil and sprinkle with 5g of sesame seeds.

instruction.en: Rinse 50g of quinoa, simmer in water for 12 minutes, then let it cool.
Cut 70g of zucchini into half-moon slices.
Cut 50g of bell pepper into strips.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add 10ml of olive oil.
Add the zucchini and bell pepper, and cook for 5 minutes.
Put the quinoa into a bowl.

instruction.ko: 구운 채소와 흰강낭콩 80g을 그 위에 올린다.
instruction.en: Top with the roasted vegetables and 80g of white beans.

instruction.en: Cool the eggs in cold water, peel, and halve them.
Thinly julienne 40g of carrot.

instruction.ko: 냄비에 물을 끓여 시금치 60g과 당근을 30초간 데친다.
instruction.en: Boil water in a pot and blanch 60g of spinach and the carrot for 30 seconds.

instruction.ko: 데친 채소를 찬물에 헹궈 물기를 짠다.
instruction.en: Rinse the blanched vegetables in cold water and squeeze out the excess water.
Put 100g of cooked barley into a bowl.
Top with the vegetables and eggs, and drizzle with 5ml of perilla oil.

Put 100g of cooked brown rice into a bowl.
Top with the edamame, broccoli, and avocado.
Sprinkle with 5g of sesame seeds.

benefits.en: Contains quercetin, a plant compound found in many vegetables.

benefits.ko: 베타카로틴이 풍부해 주황색을 띠는 뿌리채소예요.
benefits.en: Rich in beta-carotene, which gives it its orange color.

benefits.ko: 수분 함량이 높고 아삭한 식감의 채소예요.
benefits.en: A crunchy vegetable with high water content.

benefits.ko: 불포화지방 비중이 높은 식물성 기름이에요.
benefits.en: A plant-based oil with a high proportion of unsaturated fat.

instruction.en: Dice 60g of onion, 60g of carrot, and 40g of celery.
Heat a pot over medium heat and add 10ml of olive oil.
Add the diced vegetables and sauté for 3 minutes.
Add 120g of chicken breast.
Pour in 300ml of water.
Once it boils, reduce to low heat.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

instruction.ko: 닭가슴살을 꺼내 두 갈래로 찢은 뒤 다시 넣는다.
instruction.en: Take out the chicken, shred it into pieces, and return it to the pot.

description.ko: 두부와 버섯을 함께 볶아 낸 담백한 저녁입니다.
description.en: A light dinner of tofu stir-fried with mushrooms.

benefits.ko: 콩으로 만든 식물성 단백질 식품이에요.
benefits.en: A plant-based protein food made from soybeans.

benefits.ko: 식이섬유와 비타민 D 전구체가 들어 있는 버섯이에요.
benefits.en: Contains fiber and a precursor to vitamin D.

benefits.ko: 칼슘과 비타민 K가 들어 있는 잎채소예요.
benefits.en: A leafy green that contains calcium and vitamin K.

benefits.ko: 백미보다 식이섬유가 많이 남아있는 통곡물이에요.
benefits.en: A whole grain that retains more fiber than white rice.

benefits.ko: 불포화지방 비중이 높은 식물성 기름이에요.
benefits.en: A plant-based oil with a high proportion of unsaturated fat.

instruction.en: Cut 150g of tofu into thick slices.
Thinly slice 80g of shiitake mushrooms.

instruction.ko: 청경채 70g을 밑동을 잘라내고 한 잎씩 뗀다.
instruction.en: Trim the base of 70g of bok choy and separate the leaves.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add 10ml of olive oil.

instruction.ko: 두부를 올려 앞뒤로 각 2분씩 노릇하게 굽는다.
instruction.en: Add the tofu and brown each side for 2 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the bok choy and stir-fry for 1 more minute.
Serve with 80g of cooked brown rice.

description.ko: 연어와 브로콜리를 함께 구워 낸 저녁 한 접시입니다.
description.en: Salmon and broccoli roasted together on one plate.

benefits.ko: 오메가-3 지방산이 풍부해 혈관 건강에 도움이 될 수 있어요.
benefits.en: Rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which may support heart health.

benefits.ko: 비타민 C와 식이섬유가 풍부한 십자화과 채소예요.
benefits.en: A cruciferous vegetable rich in vitamin C and fiber.

benefits.ko: 곡물 중에서는 드물게 단백질을 고루 갖춘 씨앗류예요.
benefits.en: A seed that, unlike most grains, contains a fairly complete protein profile.

benefits.ko: 불포화지방 비중이 높은 식물성 기름이에요.
benefits.en: A plant-based oil with a high proportion of unsaturated fat.

benefits.ko: 비타민 C가 풍부하고 상큼한 산미를 더해줘요.
benefits.en: Rich in vitamin C and adds bright acidity.

instruction.en: Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F).

instruction.ko: 퀴노아 50g을 헹궈 냄비에 물과 함께 넣고 12분간 끓인다.
instruction.en: Rinse 50g of quinoa, then simmer in water for 12 minutes.
Place 120g of salmon and 100g of broccoli on a baking tray.
Drizzle evenly with 10ml of olive oil.
Bake for 12 minutes.

instruction.ko: 구운 연어와 브로콜리를 삶은 퀴노아와 함께 접시에 담는다.
instruction.en: Plate the roasted salmon and broccoli with the cooked quinoa.
Squeeze 20g of lemon juice over the plate.

description.ko: 달걀과 채소를 팬에 구워 낸 이탈리아식 프리타타입니다.
description.en: An Italian-style frittata of eggs and vegetables.

benefits.ko: 단백질과 여러 비타민을 고루 갖춘 식재료예요.
benefits.en: A food that provides protein along with a range of vitamins.

benefits.ko: 철분과 엽산이 들어 있는 잎채소예요.
benefits.en: A leafy green that contains iron and folate.

benefits.ko: 퀘르세틴이라는 식물성 화합물이 들어 있는 채소예요.
benefits.en: Contains quercetin, a plant compound found in many vegetables.

benefits.ko: 라이코펜이라는 항산화 성분이 들어 있는 채소예요.
benefits.en: Contains lycopene, an antioxidant compound.

benefits.ko: 불포화지방 비중이 높은 식물성 기름이에요.
benefits.en: A plant-based oil with a high proportion of unsaturated fat.

instruction.en: Dice 50g of onion.

instruction.ko: 달걀 3개를 그릇에 깨서 넣고 잘 푼다.
instruction.en: Crack 3 eggs into a bowl and beat well.
Heat a pan over medium-low heat and add 10ml of olive oil.
Add the onion and sauté for 2 minutes.

instruction.ko: 시금치 60g을 넣고 숨이 죽을 때까지 1분간 볶는다.
instruction.en: Add 60g of spinach and sauté for 1 minute until wilted.
Pour the beaten eggs into the pan.
Halve 60g of cherry tomatoes and arrange them on top.
Cover and cook on low heat for 8 minutes.

description.ko: 렌틸콩을 토마토와 함께 끓여낸 지중해식 스튜입니다.
description.en: A Mediterranean stew of lentils simmered with tomatoes.

benefits.ko: 식물성 단백질과 식이섬유가 풍부한 콩류예요.
benefits.en: A legume rich in plant-based protein and fiber.

benefits.ko: 라이코펜이라는 항산화 성분이 들어 있는 채소예요.
benefits.en: Contains lycopene, an antioxidant compound.

benefits.ko: 퀘르세틴이라는 식물성 화합물이 들어 있는 채소예요.

benefits.en: A leafy green that contains iron and folate.

benefits.ko: 불포화지방 비중이 높은 식물성 기름이에요.
benefits.en: A plant-based oil with a high proportion of unsaturated fat.

instruction.en: Dice 50g of onion.
Roughly chop 120g of tomato.
Heat a pot over medium heat and add 10ml of olive oil.
Add the onion and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato and sauté for 2 more minutes.
Add 90g of lentils and 200ml of water.
Once it boils, reduce to low heat and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add 50g of spinach and stir for 1 minute until wilted.

description.ko: 고등어를 구워 데친 채소와 함께 낸 저녁 한 상입니다.
description.en: Grilled mackerel served with blanched greens.

benefits.ko: 오메가-3 지방산이 풍부해 혈관 건강에 도움이 될 수 있어요.
benefits.en: Rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which may support heart health.

benefits.ko: 철분과 엽산이 들어 있는 잎채소예요.
benefits.en: A leafy green that contains iron and folate.

benefits.ko: 백미보다 식이섬유가 많이 남아있는 통곡물이에요.
benefits.en: A whole grain that retains more fiber than white rice.

benefits.ko: 수분 함량이 높고 소화 효소가 들어 있다고 알려진 뿌리채소예요.
benefits.en: A root vegetable known for its high water content and natural digestive enzymes.

benefits.ko: 오메가-3 지방산 비중이 높은 식물성 기름이에요.
benefits.en: A plant-based oil with a high proportion of omega-3 fatty acids.

instruction.en: Heat a pan over medium heat.
Place the 120g mackerel skin-side down.
Sprinkle on just a small pinch of salt.
Cook for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook for another 4 minutes.
Grate 50g of daikon radish.
Boil water in a pot and blanch 80g of spinach for 30 seconds.

instruction.ko: 데친 시금치의 물기를 짜고 들기름 5ml로 무친다.
instruction.en: Squeeze the water out of the spinach and dress it with 5ml of perilla oil.

instruction.ko: 현미밥 80g, 구운 고등어, 무친 시금치, 간 무를 그릇에 함께 담는다.
instruction.en: Plate the brown rice, grilled mackerel, dressed spinach, and grated daikon together.
